notes: Prerequisite `tech_id` values are resolved to {tree_label, tech_type, name_key, at_level}.
Prerequisite `building_id` values are resolved to {build_type, name_key, at_level, icon_sprite_path}.
English display names (e.g. 'Serpent's Rise' for tech_type 344 in Boss Boost) are NOT in the APK — the game downloads them from CDN at first launch.
Icons are extracted separately by extract_tech_icons.py — filenames match `icon_sprite_path`.

normalizations: Squad 2-4 copied squad 1 targets corrected to their respective squad numbers.
Palmon Onslaught corrected to attack +1% per level.
Palmon Total Defense corrected to defense +1% per level.
Final Damage / FinalDamage normalized to finalDamage.
Armigo Capacity / armigoCapacity normalized to allPalmonArmigoCapacity.
Super Armigo Damage Resistance modeled as positive finalDamageTakenReduction.
Desert Mastery caller groups modeled by element, stat and attacking/defending camp condition.
